sahneler.metin: On the night Chicago burned, a far deadlier fire swept Wisconsin.
It became a firestorm that killed well over a thousand people.
Settlers and railroads cleared forest with fire.
The weather had been unusually dry.
A cold front brought strong winds.
Many small fires merged into one.
It burned more than a million acres.
It's the deadliest wildfire in recorded history.

aciklama:
Peshtigo burned across Wisconsin and Michigan. The cause: slash-and-burn fires merging into a firestorm driven by strong winds.
